title: Jeweler Customer Acquisition Made Easy with CaratBase
description: CaratBase sends leads to independent jewelers, estate buyers and appraisers from people selling gold, seeking appraisals or buying rings. 3 free, then $40.
html:
Jeweler Customer Acquisition

CaratBase sends leads to independent jewelers, estate buyers, and appraisers, connecting you with people looking to sell gold, get appraisals, or buy engagement rings. Start with 3 free leads, then pay $40 for each accepted lead.

What you get

  • First 3 leads free
  • $40 per accepted lead thereafter
  • Optional Pro website widget at $12/month

Why CaratBase

CaratBase is starting in Atlanta and plans to expand to other metros.

FAQ

How much does it cost? The first 3 leads are free. After that, each accepted lead costs $40. A Pro website widget is optional at $12/month.

Can I cancel the Pro widget? Yes. The Pro widget can be cancelled whenever, and it drops back to the free version.

Next Step

Learn more at caratbase.com.
